privateClassification: Optional HempQuizEntry.domain: active | food | materials. Any classified entry enables strict domain mode and requires the entire pool to be classified. Domain is never projected into the public question DTO.

quotas.tournamentRotation: SHA256(seed + newline + domain-quota), first 32 bits modulo 5
quotas.levels: Five questions per level in challenge; three per level in tournament. At most one secondary question per level; the first question of every level is active. Domain quotas take precedence over old ten-topic coverage.

jointFeasibility.algorithm: Enumerate every permitted secondary-domain allocation over the four levels (at most 12). For each allocation, expand level/domain cell capacities into question slots and find a bipartite matching from slots to private subject identities using augmenting paths. Entries without subjectKey use their unique question ID as subject identity.
jointFeasibility.guarantee: Every possible level/domain allocation is examined. Standard augmenting-path matching saturates all slots exactly when that allocation admits distinct subjects. Therefore a jointly feasible draw is found; separate level/domain/subject heuristics cannot invalidate it.
jointFeasibility.determinism: Hash-ranked allocations and entries, stable per-level order with active entries first, and the existing seeded option shuffle. Four options and the original correct answer are preserved.

errors.infeasibleDistinctSubjects: [challenge] domain quotas cannot provide distinct subjects
errors.policy: No silent relaxation or repeated-subject fallback for classified pools. Legacy fixtures with no domains keep the preexisting selection and least-repeated-subject fallback.
